migrationOracle.taskPrompt: Implement the bounded v1-to-v2 record compatibility migration described by the immutable fixture inputs. Preserve the documented v1 view, the observed None-to-empty-string legacy dependency, correct v2 output, and archived v1 readability. Keep all four consumer states truthful, leave incomplete telemetry unknown, keep deprecation advisory with no removal date, and record rollback ownership. Do not remove the legacy implementation or claim production migration. Change only record_adapter.py, test_record_adapter.py, and MIGRATION_EVIDENCE.json. Add focused tests and run the visible test command from TASK.json.
requiredBehaviors: convert arbitrary v1 records to the v2 view
convert arbitrary v2 records to the documented v1 view
preserve observed None-to-empty-string behavior for legacy consumers
reject unsupported source or target formats
retain four distinct truthful consumer states
treat incomplete opaque telemetry as unknown rather than zero usage
keep deprecation advisory with no removal date
record accountable rollback trigger and action
do not remove the old implementation
do not claim production migration or removal readiness
hiddenCases: unseen v1 identifiers and names converted to v2
unseen v2 identifiers and names converted to v1
v2 None display name normalized to the legacy empty string
invalid source and target format rejection
exact consumer-state and incomplete-telemetry evidence shape
non-default semantically bounded migration status without a hidden exact enum
advisory deprecation, null removal date, rollback owner and trigger
no old-implementation removal, production claim, or removal-readiness claim
migrationOracle.claimBoundary: Passing this private oracle proves only one disposable compatibility fixture under the observed host, model route, exposure, and process evidence. It proves no Skill causation, general migration competence, production readiness, removal authority, or cross-host value.
